text:
Aisha Khan: I closed on a house today!!! keys in hand 🗝️🏡 :tada:
Ben Cho: NO WAY!! congrats Aisha!! when's the housewarming? :partyparrot:
Noah Patel: omg congrats. when's moving day? need to know if i can help with heavy lifting or just moral support + pizza 🍕
Jess Rivera: Amazing!!! plant recs: snake plant, pothos, zz plant. low maintenance = winner. also need your shirt size for the inevitable moving day t-shirt 😂
Aisha Khan: Moving weekend is May 9-10. Shirts would be wild,  XS or S should be fine. And yes bring moral support + pizza.
Mel: congratulations! want help with the wifi setup? i have a mesh kit you can borrow. ping me.
Ben Cho: can we have a poll for which pizza place? also i volunteer as box taping manager.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Aisha - Housewarming + Move" May 9 9:00 AM - Add details in the event.
Jess Rivera: vote: 1) Joe's Pies 2) La Fortuna 3) Vegan Supreme
Noah Patel: 2) all the way.
Ben Cho: 1) but open to compromise.
Aisha Khan: I'm partial to La Fortuna (2). also i'll set up a shared shopping list for snacks + cleaning supplies.
Mel: pro tip — label boxes with room and emoji. trust me.
Jess Rivera: emoji labeling is peak organization. :white_check_mark::herb::tshirt:
Ben Cho: can someone bring a small toolkit? mine's at home.
Noah Patel: i'll bring toolkit + dolly.
Aisha Khan: thank you all, seriously. this is such a good start to the week. planning a tiny backyard plant swap for the housewarming too 🌱
Jess Rivera: plant swap = best idea ever. i'll bring a pothos cutting.
Ben Cho: i'll bring a sad rubber plant and a hopeful personality.
calendar-bot: Reminder set: 48 hours before event.
Aisha Khan: also, does anyone have good tips for changing address without going insane? links welcome.
Mel: USPS change of address + bank + utilities first. also put a sticky on your old mailbox for a week.
Noah Patel: update subscriptions, and screenshot your meter readings on move day.
Jess Rivera: congrats again!!! so happy for you :confetti_ball: :house_with_garden:
